title: Silent stationary input move
statement: Let $x$ be a finite binary input, let $q$ be any optional control state, let $q'$ be a control state, and let $i\le |x|$. For any work word $u$, work-head position $h\in\mathbb Z$, output word $o$, and work-head displacement $e\in\{-1,0,1\}$, applying the silent action that leaves the input head stationary, moves the work head by $e$, and enters $q'$ produces the configuration with state $q'$, the same input-head position, work word, and output, and work-head position $h+e$.
replaced:
Let $x$ be an input and $i \le |x|$. Applying the silent action that keeps the input
head fixed, moves the work head by $e$, and enters state $q'$ to a non-tautology
verifier configuration on $x$ in any state with $i$ input bits consumed, work word $u$, work head
$h$, and output $o$ yields the configuration in state $q'$ with the same index, $u$,
and $o$, and work head $h + e$.
